_verify: CHECK EVERY FIELD on pmuy.gov.in before the demo. Rules and subsidy change.
name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) - free LPG gas connection
who_can_apply: An adult woman (18 years or older)
From a poor household: BPL, SC/ST, PMAY house beneficiary, Antyodaya (AAY) ration card, forest dweller, tea/ex-tea garden tribe, island or river-island resident, most backward classes
No other LPG connection already in the household
eligibility_questions_in_order: Is the woman 18 years or older?
Does your household already have a gas (LPG) connection?
Does your family have a priority/Antyodaya ration card, or belong to SC/ST or another poor-household group?
documents: Bank passbook (bank account in her name)
Address proof (migrants can give a self-declaration)
where_to_apply: Nearest LPG gas agency (Indane, HP Gas or Bharat Gas), or online at pmuy.gov.in. Ask the agency for the Ujjwala form (KYC form).
what_to_say: I want a new Ujjwala gas connection.
cost_note: Connection deposit is covered by the scheme. The subsidy on refills and the stove/first refill arrangement can change - verify.
